name: AiLevelF
description: Returns the difficulty level of the player's AI as float value (unlike AILevel trigger, which is still floored for compatibility reasons). If AI is enabled on the player, the value ranges from 1 (easiest) to 8 (most difficult). If AI is not enabled on the player, the return value is 0. AI difficulty level with floating point is a result of AI Ramping system (refer to select.def distributed with engine for more information)

name: AirJumpCount
description: Returns the number of (conventional) air jumps the P1 has performed.

name: Alpha
description: Returns the value of the player's source/dest alpha applied with Trans sctrl.

name: Analog
description: Returns the value of the player's respective analog axis. Values are normalized from [-1,1] with the exception of analog triggers (RightTrigger and LeftTrigger) which are normalized to [0.0,1.0].
arguments: LeftX, LeftY, RightX, RightY, LeftTrigger, RightTrigger

name: Angle
description: Returns the value of the player's angle applied with AngleDraw/AngleSet/AngleAdd/AngleMul sctrl.

name: AnimElemVar
description: Returns information about the player's current animation frame as defined in the AIR file. Refer to the AIR file documentation for what each parameter means. Note: This trigger was also called AnimFrame at one point during development.

name: AnimLength
description: Returns total length of the P1 current animation.

name: AnimPlayerNo
description: Returns the player number of the owner of the player's current animation. Normally returns the same number as the player's player number, but when for instance ChangeAnim2 is used in a custom state, it will return the number of who owns that animation.

name: Atan2
description: Takes two arguments, and returns the arc tangent of the two specified arguments.

name: Attack
description: Returns P1 current attack value.

name: AttackMul
description: Returns the player's current attackmul value.

name: BgmVar
description: Allows checking the filename, freqmul, length, loop, loopcount, loopend, loopstart, position, startposition, and volume of the currently playing BGM.

name: BotBoundBodyDist
description: Like BotBoundDist, except this trigger accounts for the player's bottom edge parameter, as defined by the Depth state controller.

name: BotBoundDist
description: BotBoundDist gives the distance between the player's z-axis and the botbound limit of the stage.

name: Clamp
description: Takes three arguments, returns a value clamped to an inclusive range of two specified arguments.

name: ClsnOverlap
description: Returns true if the player's specified collision box type is overlapping another player's collision boxes. This trigger uses Ikemen's internal collision detection, so it will work even with angled and rescaled boxes.

name: ClsnVar
description: Returns the specified CLSN coordinate from the specified CLSN index. Back always returns the back coordinate, and front always returns the front coordinate, even if they are reversed in the .AIR file. All coordinates are in the same coordinate space as .AIR.

name: ComboCount
description: Returns the total number of hits done by the player's side in the currently ongoing combo. This value is valid as long as the opposite team combo count stays above 0, otherwise it returns 0 too. Returned value always matches current combo counter tracked by lifebar.

name: Command
description: If a character has ikemenversion, when the Command trigger is redirected to another player, the engine will first check if the other player is performing its own command with the same name. If not, it'll check if it's performing the command from our own command list. Otherwise it will work like Mugen.

name: ConsecutiveWins
description: Returns number of matches won consecutively by this team side. The counter increases for the winning team at the same time MatchOver trigger starts returning 1. Losing a round resets the counter to 0 and prevents increment for this match.

name: Const
description: The Const trigger can now also read Ikemen GO's new constants.

name: Const1080p
description: Converts a value from the 1080p coordinate space to the player's coordinate space. The conversion ratio between coordinate spaces is the ratio of their widths.

name: DebugMode
description: Returns information related to the debug mode.

name: DecisiveRound
description: Returns 1 if the match will conclude if the player's team wins.

name: Defence
description: Returns the player's current defence value. This value accounts for all defence multipliers.

name: DefenceMul
description: Returns the player's current defencemul value.

name: Deg
description: Converts an argument value from radians to degrees.

name: DisplayName
description: Returns the player's displayed name. Note that the lifebar name is not necessarily the same.

name: Dizzy
description: Returns 1 if character is under dizzy effect (assigned by DizzySet/#newdizzyset) sctrl).

name: DizzyPoints
description: Returns the amount of dizzy points the player has.

name: DizzyPointsMax
description: Returns the maximum amount of dizzy points the player can have. This is normally the same value as LifeMax (adjustable in character's CNS [Data] section).

name: DrawPal
description: returns the value of the group and index of the palette being used to draw the sprites at the moment, unlike PalNo, which returns the palette selected in the character select screen.

name: EnvShakeVar
description: Allows checking the (remaining) time, frequency and amplitude of the current EnvShake.

name: ExplodVar
description: Returns the specified explod parameter. Use -1 for ID to iterate over all explods.

name: FightScreenState
description: Allows checking if the fight screen is displaying specific screens.

name: FightScreenVar
description: Returns information about the fight screen (commonly referred to as "lifebars").

name: FightTime
description: Returns the amount of ticks since the start of the actual fight.

name: FirstAttack
description: Returns 1 if this character has landed the first attack (before any of the opponents or team partners) in the current round. Otherwise returns 0.

name: Float
description: Converts argument evaluating to int type into float type.

name: GameHeight
description: If mugenVersion is specified as 1.0 in character's [[Info]](Character-features/#definfo) section, GameHeight returns the same value as ScreenHeight.

name: GameMode
description: Returns the current game mode.

name: GameOption
description: Allows checking the various game options as defined in config.ini (TBD) Keep in mind that until string support is added to the engine, only numeric values are useful to return.

name: GameVar
description: Allows checking some system variables that generally don't justify having their own dedicated triggers.

name: GameWidth
description: If mugenVersion is specified as 1.0 in character's [[Info]](Character-features/#definfo) section, GameWidth returns the same value as ScreenWidth.

name: GetHitVar
description: Returns the X, Y or Z component of the last HitDef's air.velocity parameter, even if the player was not hit in the air. (float)

name: GroundAngle
description: TODO: ? Related to undocumented PlatformAngle/#changedprojectileplatformangle) projectile parameter.

name: GroundLevel
description: Returns the character's ground level, which is normally 0 but can be changed via GroundLevelOffset/#newgroundleveloffset).

name: GuardBreak
description: Returns 1 if character is under guard break (assigned by GuardBreakSet/#newguardbreakset) sctrl).

name: GuardCount
description: Returns how many hits of the current attack were guarded. Similar to Hitcount.

name: GuardPoints
description: Returns the amount of guard points the player has.

name: GuardPointsMax
description: Returns the maximum amount of guard points the player can have. This is normally the same value as LifeMax (adjustable in character's CNS [Data] section).

name: Helper
description: The Helper redirection now also accepts an optional index argument, through the new format Helper(ID, index). Defaults to 0 (first one). The old formats still work exactly the same.

name: HelperIndex
description: Redirects the trigger to the helper entity by index.

name: HelperIndexExist
description: Returns 1 if a player's helper with the specified index number exists, or 0 otherwise. Example:

name: HelperName
description: Returns the helper's name (assigned via helper's name parameter, which defaults to "\'s helper" if a unique name is not assigned).

name: HelperVar
description: Returns a helper's unique properties. If called from a root player, the return is always invalid.

name: HitByAttr
description: Checks if the player can be hit by an attack with the specified attribute. See also documentation for the attr parameter in HitDef as well as HitDefAttr.

name: HitDefVar
description: Returns information about the player's currently active HitDef or ReversalDef. The parameter format is the same as in the HitDef state controller. Note: When the player has no active HitDef or ReversalDef, this trigger will return the default values of each parameter. It is generally advised to check if a HitDef or ReversalDef is active first with HitDefAttr or ReversalDefAttr.

name: HitOverridden
description: Returns 1 during frame in which player has overridden default gethit behavior via HitOverride state controller. Otherwise returns 0.

name: IkemenVersion
description: Returns one component of the character's Ikemen version as an integer.

name: InCustomAnim
description: Returns 1 if the character is in a custom animation, such as when ChangeAnim2 is used in a custom state.

name: InCustomState
description: Returns 1 if the character is in a custom state (sent into another player's state).

name: Index
description: Returns the player's index as an integer. See PlayerIndex/#redirectionplayerindex).

name: InDialogue
description: Returns 1 during ongoing dialogue initiated by Dialogue/#newdialogue) state controller.

name: InputTime
description: Returns number of frames since a given button was pressed or released. A positive number means the button is being held, while a negative number means it has been released. For players without keyctrl, it returns 0.

name: IntroState
description: Returns the current intro state number: 0: Not applicable, or players have gained ctrl after "fight!" 1: Pre-intro (RoundState = 0) 2: Player intros (RoundState = 1) 3: Round announcement 4: Fight called

name: IsAsserted
description: Returns 1 if the character has specified AssertSpecial state controller flag asserted. Flags that affect all characters at once don't have to be asserted directly by character to be detectable.

name: IsClsnProxy
description: Returns if the helper is a Clsn Proxy#clsnproxy).

name: IsHelper
description: The IsHelper trigger now also accepts an optional index argument, through the new format IsHelper(ID, index). Defaults to -1 (any index). The old formats still work exactly the same.

name: IsHost
description: Returns if the player is host in online match.

name: JugglePoints
description: Returns the remaining juggle points between the player and another player with the specified ID. If the specified ID is not yet a target of the first player, the trigger will simply return the maximum juggle points.

name: LastPlayerID
description: Returns the ID number of the last spawned player or helper.

name: LayerNo
description: Returns the layer number on which the character is currently being drawn on.

name: Lerp
description: Linear interpolation. Takes three arguments, and returns a number between two specified arguments at a specific increment.

name: LocalCoord
description: Returns the character's localcoord as a float. This trigger returns a constant value even when the player is in a custom state.

name: Map
description: Use the name of the map you want to recognize in parentheses. For example, a character with the below map will return Map(age) as a value set in character DEF file or via various state controllers that can modify character's map. If nothing is set, 0 is returned.

name: Max
description: Takes two arguments, and returns the highest-valued number.

name: MemberNo
description: Returns character's team member position. Team leader is 1, while partners receive successive numbers. In Tag mode this value is dynamic.

name: Min
description: Takes two arguments, and returns the lowest-valued number.

name: MotifState
description: Allows retrieval of whether the specified post-round sequence is active.

name: MotifVar
description: Allows checking the various screenpack options as defined in system.def (TBD) Keep in mind that until string support is added to the engine, only numeric values are useful to return.

name: MoveCountered
description: This trigger is valid only when the player is in an attack state. MoveCountered returns 1 on attack contact, at the exact frame that p1 interrupts p2 attack (true for 1 frame, even if both P1 and P2 countered each other's moves). After contact, MoveCountered's return value will increase by 1 for each game tick that P1 is not paused. It gives 0 otherwise. See Details section of Mugen's MoveContact trigger for more information.

name: MoveHitVar
description: Similarly to GetHitVar, this trigger allows retrieving information about the last hit the player inflicted. This trigger works even if that hit acquired no target.

name: MugenVersion
description: Returns one component of the character's Mugen version as an integer.

name: NumPlayer
description: Returns total number of players (including helpers, attached chars, etc) existing ingame. Example:

name: NumStageBG
description: Returns the number of BG elements in the stage that have the specified ID. If the ID argument is not used, or if ID is -1, it returns the total.

name: NumText
description: This trigger takes an ID number as an optional argument. If the ID number is omitted, NumText returns the number of texts owned by the player. If the ID number is included, then NumText returns the number of texts with that ID number that are owned by the player. The ID number must be greater than -1. An ID number of -1 or less will give the same behavior as if the ID number is omitted.

name: Offset
description: Returns the value of the player's x,y offset applied with OffSet sctrl.

name: OutroState
description: Returns the current outro state number: 0: Not applicable 1: Payers can still act, allowing a possible double KO 2: Players still have control, but the match outcome can no longer be changed 3: Players lose control, but the round has not yet entered win states 4: Player win states 5: Round over (starting from the last frame of the RoundState sequence and continuing through the entire post-round sequence, individually detactable with MotifState#motifstate) trigger)

name: P2
description: Redirects the trigger to the same player as the "P2" family of triggers (P2StateNo, etc). So, for instance, P2, StateNo is equivalent to P2StateNo.

name: P2Dist
description: The P2Dist trigger now also accepts a Z argument. Returns the distance between the players in the Z axis.

name: P5Name
description: Same as P1Name-P4Name, except that these return the name of other team members, if present. If there is no such opponent, then it returns 0 no matter what name is specified. Similarly, P5Name != "name" will return 1 no matter what name is specified.

name: P6Name
description: Same as P1Name-P4Name, except that these return the name of other team members, if present. If there is no such opponent, then it returns 0 no matter what name is specified. Similarly, P5Name != "name" will return 1 no matter what name is specified.

name: P7Name
description: Same as P1Name-P4Name, except that these return the name of other team members, if present. If there is no such opponent, then it returns 0 no matter what name is specified. Similarly, P5Name != "name" will return 1 no matter what name is specified.

name: P8Name
description: Same as P1Name-P4Name, except that these return the name of other team members, if present. If there is no such opponent, then it returns 0 no matter what name is specified. Similarly, P5Name != "name" will return 1 no matter what name is specified.

name: PalFXVar
description: [TODO] Returns information about the player, background or global ("all") PalFX. Accepted parameters:

name: ParentDist
description: The ParentDist trigger now also accepts a Z argument. Returns the distance between the helper and its parent in the Z axis.

name: ParentExist
description: Returns true if the helper's parent is still present in the game. Example:

name: PauseTime
description: Returns the time until the active Pause and/or SuperPause effect expires (whichever lasts longer). The non 0 value is returned only after movetime parameter of these sctrls expires (player can no longer move).

name: Physics
description: Returns the player's physics-type. Refer to the section on StateDef in the CNS documentation for more details on physics.

name: Player
description: Redirects a trigger to the character with the specified PlayerNo. Example:

name: PlayerIndex
description: Each player is assigned a specific index in the internal player list. PlayerIndex will redirect a trigger to the player (helpers included) with the specified index. The first index is 0. If there are 20 players on screen, valid indexes will be 0 through 19. Like all "index" triggers, this is especially useful in for and while loops. Example:

name: PlayerIndexExist
description: Returns 1 if a player with the specified index number exists, 0 otherwise. See PlayerIndex/#redirectionplayerindex). Example:

name: PlayerNo
description: Returns character's player number. Player 1 side uses odd numbers (1, 3, 5, 7), player 2 side even numbers (2, 4, 6, 8). Stage AttachedChar uses number outside maximum player range (9).

name: PlayerNoExist
description: Evaluates if the specified player number is currently in use.

name: PrevAnim
description: Returns the number of the anim that the player was last in.

name: PrevMoveType
description: Returns the MoveType that the player was last in.

name: PrevStateType
description: Returns the StateType that the player was last in.

name: ProjClsnOverlap
description: Returns true if the projectile's collision box (either clsn1 or clsn2) overlaps with another player's collision boxes. This trigger uses Ikemen's internal collision detection, so it will work even with angled and rescaled boxes. If you want to specify a projectile with a specific projID, create a loop process that combines the projID with ProjVar.

name: ProjVar
description: Returns the specified projectile parameter. Use -1 for ID to iterate over all projectiles.

name: Rad
description: Converts an argument value from degree to radians.

name: RandomRange
description: Generates pseudo-random integer numbers uniformly distributed between the given range (both bounds inclusive).

name: ReceivedDamage
description: Returns the total damage dealt by the opposite team to this character, in the currently ongoing combo. This value is valid as long as the opposite team combo count stays above 0, otherwise it returns 0 too.

name: ReceivedHits
description: Returns the total number of hits done by the opposite team to this character, in the currently ongoing combo. Unlike GetHitVar(hitcount), it takes into account all hits, including those applied by HitAdd. This value is valid as long as the opposite team combo count stays above 0, otherwise it returns 0 too.

name: RedLife
description: Returns the amount of red life the player has.

name: ReversalDefAttr
description: Checks the attribute parameter of the player's currently-active ReversalDef. If the player does not currently have an active ReversalDef, then no parameters will match. Can be used for AI to detect a counter or to code something to happen if it exists.

name: RootDist
description: The RootDist trigger now also accepts a Z argument. Returns the distance between the helper and its root in the Z axis.

name: Round
description: Returns the rounded value of val to specified precision (number of digits after the decimal point). precision can also be negative or zero.

name: RoundState
description: The RoundState trigger no longer returns 2 during the "Fight!" screen, before players have control, returning 1 instead. RoundState = 2 is generally understood and documented as the main part of the fight, so this oddity only caused trouble in Mugen.

name: RoundsWon
description: Returns how many total rounds the teamside has won during the current match. Resets between matches.

name: RoundTime
description: Returns the tick count since the start of the round.

name: RunOrder
description: At the start of each frame, players are sorted into a list for code processing based on their current actions (see character processing order). RunOrder returns their position in this list as an integer.

name: Scale
description: Returns the value of the player's drawing scale. Scale X and Scale Y refer to the scale applied by AngleDraw. Scale Z refers to the rescaling that affects the player when moving in the Z space.

name: Score
description: Returns the score points gained in this round by all team members.

name: ScoreTotal
description: Returns the total score points value. Takes into account all team members, previous rounds and previous matches since the start of this game mode.

name: SelfCommand
description: [TODO]

name: SelfStatenoExist
description: Checks for the existence of a state only within P1's state numbers, even when P1 is custom stated by a hit. Returns 1 if there is a statedef with the specified number. Otherwise it returns 0. Use the statedef number you want to recognize in parentheses.

name: Shader
description: Returns the name of the custom shader applied to the player. If no custom shader is applied, "" is returned.

name: Sign
description: Returns the sign of a real number. If value 0 return 1.

name: SoundVar
description: Returns the specified sound channel parameter. Use -1 for channelNo to find the first sound available.

name: SpritePlayerNo
description: Returns the player number of the owner of the player's current sprite. Normally returns the same number as the player's player number, but when for instance ChangeAnim2 is used in a custom state, it will return the number of who owns that sprite.

name: SpriteVar
description: Returns information about the player's current sprite.

name: SprPriority
description: Returns the player's/helper's current SprPriority value.

name: StageBackEdgeDist
description: Returns the distance to the stage edge (corner) behind the player.

name: StageBGVar
description: Returns information about the stage's BG elements.

name: StageConst
description: Returns the value of one of the stage's constants. Stage constant variables can be set under stage's DEF [[Constants]](Stage-features/#constants) section.

name: StageFrontEdgeDist
description: Returns the distance to the stage edge (corner) in front of the player.

name: StageTime
description: Returns the stage's internal time, or the amount of ticks since the last stage reset. The value returned by this trigger corresponds directly to the amount of times stage backgrounds have been updated (taking into account pausebg, resetbg, etc), allowing one to for instance reliably synchronize attachedchar actions to what's currently displayed by the stage.

name: StageVar
description: StageVar now accepts all stage parameters that ModifyStageVar/#newmodifystagevar) state controller can change. In addition it accepts the following parameters:

name: Standby
description: Returns 1 if character is under standby effect (assigned by TagOut/#newtagout) sctrl).

name: StateOwner
description: Redirects a trigger to the owner of the current state the character is in. Useful when a custom stated target needs to redirect a trigger to the player. Note: states are owned by the root. Example:

name: Target
description: The Target redirection now also accepts an optional index argument, through the new format Target(ID, index). Defaults to 0 (first one). The old format still works exactly the same.

name: TeamLeader
description: Returns playerno/#playerno) of the character that is considered a team leader. In modes where only one player is controlled in particular round (single, turns and ratio) it will be either 1 or 2, depending on team side. In simul and tag modes, team leader is the first party member (again 1 or 2) by default, but who is considered a leader can be also dynamically adjusted via optional TagIn/#newtagin) sctrl leader parameter.

name: TeamMode
description: TeamMode can now also return Tag when that mode is selected.

name: TeamSize
description: Returns character's team size (for turns mode it returns information that was previously not obtainable, for other team modes the returned value is equivalent to using NumPartner + 1)

name: TimeElapsed
description: Returns the amount of clock ticks since the battle began (0 if time is disabled). Value returned by this trigger corresponds to lifebar timer (only ticks during RoundState = 2)

name: TimeRemaining
description: Returns the amount of clock ticks until time over (-1 if time is disabled). Value returned by this trigger corresponds to lifebar timer (only ticks during RoundState = 2)

name: TimeTotal
description: Returns the total number of clock ticks that have elapsed so far. Takes into account previous rounds and matches since the start of this game mode.

name: TopBoundBodyDist
description: Like TopBoundDist, except this trigger accounts for the player's top edge parameter, as defined by the Depth state controller.

name: TopBoundDist
description: TopBoundDist gives the distance between the player's z-axis and the topbound limit of the stage.

name: WinClutch
description: Returns true if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has won the round with health below the limit set by clutch.threshold in fight.def. If the parameter isn't defined, the default is under 10%.

name: WinHyper
description: Returns true if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has won the round with the finishing blow being a hyper attack.

name: WinSpecial
description: Returns true if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has won the round with the finishing blow being a special attack.

name: XAngle
description: Returns the value of the player's Xangle applied with AngleDraw/AngleSet/AngleAdd/AngleMul sctrl.

name: Xshear
description: Returns the value of the player's xshear applied with TransformSprite sctrl.

name: YAngle
description: Returns the value of the player's yangle applied with AngleDraw/AngleSet/AngleAdd/AngleMul sctrl.

name: ZoomVar
description: Allows checking the scale, pos x, pos y, lag, and remaining time of the currently Zoom sctrl.
